description: Process of verifying the identity of a user or system
examples: Username/password login, Multi-factor authentication (MFA), Biometric verification
synonyms: User Verification, Identity Verification, Login Authentication
business_logic: Required before granting system access; supports multiple methods (password, MFA, SSO)

description: Process of determining what resources a user can access
business_logic: Occurs after authentication; enforces least privilege principle

description: Unique identifier used to authenticate API requests
synonyms: API Token, Access Key, API Credential

description: Maximum number of API requests allowed in a time period
examples: 100 requests per minute, 10000 requests per day
synonyms: Request Quota, API Limit, Throttle Limit

description: Percentage of requests served from cache versus total requests
Data transmitted in an API request or response
synonyms: Request Body, Message Body, Data Packet

description: Specific URL path where an API can be accessed
synonyms: API Route, Service Endpoint, URL Path

description: HTTP callback that sends real-time data when events occur
examples: Payment completed webhook, User registration webhook
synonyms: HTTP Callback, Event Notification, Push Notification
